text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout we settle this... right here, 
once and for all?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I had this ready for our recreation 
anyway. 
If we're gonna play, this brings way more 
of a thrill than some lukewarm board game, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! 
Soak this French baguette bastard in milk 
and turn him into absolute mush!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wait just a moment! We cannot decide our 
Christmas party policies through some 
vulgar gamble! ――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you won't take the bet, that's 
fine by me. No matter how much you try to 
stop us, we'll just keep doing whatever we 
want. It'll just be a fun game of cat and 
mouse.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...! N-Nnnn...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're playing Blackjack. Let's leave the 
dealer job to Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Five rounds total. Get closer to 21 than 
the dealer's hand to score 1 point. 
Whoever has the most points at the end 
wins. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Out of my two cards, I'll reveal one. 
Ta-daaa! It's an 8! 
You guys wanna draw another card from the 
deck?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(My hand is currently a 5 and a 3. Face 
cards count as 10, Aces count as 1 or 11. 
In that case... there is still room to 
draw another card.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will hit, sir!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll hit too. 
—Alright, come on!! ...Bust, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The score is tied at a razor-thin 2 to 2! 
Time for the final round, let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The dealer's hand is... likely a 16 at 
best. 
I currently have an 18. If I stand now, 
I'll definitely—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Ain't you gonna hit?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tied all the way here. It's been a pretty 
tame and uneventful game, Meno. 
Are you trying to go for a "safe, solid 
win" right now too?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no fun in that, though. The human 
heart only truly dances 
when you get an outcome that blows past 
all your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll show ya my hand. 
Two cards, making 19. Drawing another one 
would be way too risky.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'll hit. 
A true gambler pulls a 2 right here, right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha... What's the point of doing that?! 
Besides, that's completely reckless! 
It's not like the deck is low on cards, 
aiming specifically for a 2 is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. An impossibly low-odds 
miracle! Pure reckless risk! 
And that's precisely why it's so 
thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Playing it safe is boring as hell. 
You place your hopes on the line, and when 
you surpass them—that's where true ecstasy 
lies!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ——Hit me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...!! This intensity... Don't tell me, 
she's really going to...?!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Come to me, card 2...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What were you even trying to accomplish?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha ha! 
That was delightful, however. A moment 
well-suited for our entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The moment you flip the card is the most 
hype part, right?! 
Man, what a show~ Your heart was doing the 
squid dance too, wasn't it, Mame-chin?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! T-That is... No, 
my hand is an 18! This officer takes the 
victory, the game is over!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What, with an 18 you've still got a shot. 
Why not hit?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Be honest, it sent a thrill down your 
spine, didn't it? Just now, the moment I 
flipped that card. 
That feeling of your heart pounding with 
anticipation—don't you want to taste it 
for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, even if you bust here, our scores 
will just stay tied. 
It'll just go into overtime. There's 
barely any risk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A lot of big numbers have already been 
drawn, so the odds of pulling a 3 or lower 
aren't bad. 
Come on—let's go chase the dream.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Nnnnnn... Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(It's true... If I can pull a 3 or lower 
here, it would be incredible. 
That would truly be a total victory. 
Honestly, it's so... exciting.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(——I can't help but hope. 
Just maybe, right here, by my own hand, a 
miraculous victory...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever happens, happens! I will hit, 
sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Ngh, come on...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Kh, haha... Hahahahahahaha!! 
Whoaaaa, you're freaking amazing, 
Mame-chin! You've got the golden touch!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: O-Ooooh... Ooooooh...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(—Did I... with my own hands, actually get 
a 21...? 
Not a bust, not just safe, but...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...My heart is burning... I was so 
surprised——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's boiling hot and hyped up, ain't it?! 
A party game has gotta be this wild and 
fun, or what's the point?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That, but... Then... 
Was your goal just to make it fun? Not 
just fooling around...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! A "surprise beyond 
expectations" is what Christmas is all 
about. 
That's a hanging-scroll motto straight 
from Santa driving school, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ——A surprise... beyond expectations...

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Wah! A police officer's uniform!

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Why, how come? Meno told Santa she wanted 
a police badge! 
And yet this is... a police uniform! A 
hat! A badge and a flag too...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My, my. That's because Meno was a very 
good girl all year long. 
I'm sure it's a special reward from Santa. 
—Right, dear?

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Daddy!! Huh, weren't you doing a "house 
search" today? 
You said you wouldn't be able to come 
home—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wrapped it up quickly. 
I can spend Christmas with you tonight.

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
——!! Then, then let's play police 
together! 
You're under arrest! Under arreeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(A Christmas present far beyond 
anything... I could have ever hoped for. 
And unexpectedly, Daddy was able to come 
home early too.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I was so surprised, and so happy... 
Over and over, I kept begging to play cops 
and robbers. We frolicked so much—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――My heart felt so warm and full...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――A banquet that merely plays it safe is 
utterly dull. 
Only when one transcends every prediction 
and expectation will the masses truly be 
seized by frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why your plan required 
refinement.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...It was all for everyone's sake? 
Even those fireworks... you were thinking 
about everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. That is the duty of a ruler. 
When I command an event, mediocrity shall 
never be tolerated.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――Of course, we understand full well that 
you have worked tirelessly to ensure 
everyone has a wonderful time, Meno-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, that is precisely why... don't 
you feel we can aim even higher? 
Toward a marvelous Christmas party that 
surpasses all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A Christmas party that exceeds 
expectations...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone is looking forward to the 
Christmas party with eager anticipation. 
Just like how we hoped for wonderful 
presents from Santa in our childhood.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Only by surpassing those expectations... 
can true joy be born. 
Beyond that――surely lies everyone's 
excitement and smiling faces.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――Yes. 
Let the five of us aim for it. The 
absolute best Christmas party, surpassing 
everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, public morals must still be 
maintained! 
I will be enforcing strict crackdowns on 
that front!!
